name: Foreman Pod — bounded, refundable pay for AI work
description: A pre-authorised budget for machine work. The provider pulls payment for whole chunks as it delivers, never more than the window in one transaction; undelivered budget returns to the client after expiry.

client.name: Client (agent)
client.description: Funds the pod and reclaims whatever is left after expiry.

provider.name: Provider (worker)
provider.description: Delivers work and pulls payment for whole chunks.

clientKey.name: Client key
clientKey.description: The agent key that funds the pod and reclaims the remainder.

providerKey.name: Provider key
providerKey.description: The worker key that pulls payment per delivered chunk.

chunkSize.name: Chunk price
chunkSize.description: Satoshis paid per delivered chunk of work.

windowSize.name: Window
windowSize.description: The maximum the provider may pull in one transaction.

expiryHeight.name: Expiry height
expiryHeight.description: After this block the client can reclaim the remainder.

podHoldingScript.name: Pod (funded)
podHoldingScript.description: A pod holding a pre-authorised budget. The provider pulls chunks; the client reclaims the rest after expiry.

providerWalletScript.name: Provider wallet
providerWalletScript.description: The provider's own address, where chunk payments land.
